tools.name: claims_analyze
tools.description: Extract policy clauses, run a preliminary text-match screen, and build a general evidence checklist. This is not legal advice or confirmation of coverage. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/claims/analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: claims_validity
tools.description: Match a caller-supplied incident to policy exclusions, dates, and the limit. The validity score falls when an exclusion's distinctive words appear in the incident, and the denial risk rises with those matches. This is a text screen, not a claim decision. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/claims/validit

tools.name: claims_letter-draft
tools.description: Prepare a human-reviewed FNOL, follow-up, or complaint letter. BRAINIAC.software does not send the message or make legal conclusions. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/claims/letter-draft. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: claims_dispute-draft
tools.description: Fill a fixed claim or dispute letter from the caller-supplied facts and the scores from a validity screen. The same fields always produce the same letter. The draft is not sent and it is not a legal filing. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/claims/dispute-draft. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment
